market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Bond yield spike to 19-year highs and oil above $103 create headwinds. Dow -300, Nasdaq -1% signal de-rating. Trump-Xi truce provides 2-month relief but farm details unresolved. Iran impasse keeps oil volatile. Expect choppy, range-bound equities with elevated VIX. Gold may find support near $4,200-4,300.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle intact per Goldman; defense spending structural; India capital market reforms create multi-year tailwinds. However, concentration risk and rate sensitivity cap upside. 6-12 month path likely sees yield normalization if inflation cools, unlocking equity re-rating. Housing and consumer remain vulnerable.
